# math_abstractions.py
# Interface definitions for math abstractions to reduce coupling

from typing import Protocol, List, runtime_checkable

@runtime_checkable
class Vector(Protocol):
    """Protocol for vector-like objects supporting element-wise operations"""
    
    def __len__(self) -> int: ...
    
    def __getitem__(self, index: int) -> float: ...
    
    def __setitem__(self, index: int, value: float) -> None: ...

@runtime_checkable
class Matrix(Protocol):
    """Protocol for matrix-like objects"""
    
    def __len__(self) -> int: ...
    
    def shape(self) -> List[int]: ...
    
    def get_row(self, i: int) -> Vector: ...
    
    def get_column(self, j: int) -> Vector: ...
